web.cli_usage: Enable the local Web control panel instead of the terminal UI (off by default); open the printed private link; Ctrl+C stops the server and runs exit cleanup
web.cli_port_usage: Local Web panel port (requires --web; 0 chooses a free port); public listening is not supported
web.started:
Web control panel: %s
This link grants control of your stream. Do not share it. Closing the browser does not quit; press Ctrl+C here to stop the server and clean up live/OBS according to your settings.
web.port_invalid: Web port must be between 0 and 65535
web.origin_denied: Cross-site access denied. Use the local link printed at startup
web.unauthorized: The access token is invalid or expired. Reopen the private link printed at startup
web.method_invalid: This endpoint does not support that request method
web.request_invalid: The request is malformed or too large
web.unavailable: The control panel is not responding. Check that the application is still running
